name: Dig | Org Digest
tagline: One company signal, five briefing altitudes from daily to annual
description: One stream of company signal, rewritten five times at five different heights. The daily note goes to the stand-up, the weekly cut to the team, the monthly view to a department, and the quarterly and yearly versions are shaped for a board or a shareholder audience. Nobody gets a briefing pitched at the wrong level.
author: damianoredem
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
